name: topbar-menu
title: Topbar Menu
description: The small-screen half of `Topbar`: a "Menu" button that opens the site's links in a panel at the edge of the screen. Topbar renders it for you below `md`; it is exported on its own for headers that compose their own row.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/topbar-menu

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/topbar-menu.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/topbar-menu';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/topbar-menu

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
